    All Classes and Interfaces

    Classes
    Class
    Description
    AddTableLootModifier
    Rolls another loot table into the generated loot after this modifier's conditions pass.
    ForgeAutomationPlayer
    Stable Forge automation player used by dispenser-owned actions.
    ForgeBBItem
    Forge finite-bucket item shell providing stack-aware crafting remainder hooks and the lava-fuel burn time.
    ForgeBucketFluidHandler
    Single-tank item fluid capability for both Some Buckets fluid items.
    ForgeBucketLootModifierProvider
    Generates Forge global loot modifiers from the cross-loader bucket-loot manifest.
    ForgeBucketOperations
    Forge fluid primitives behind the shared bucket interaction flow.
    ForgeClientSetup
    Single client lifecycle bootstrap: registers the item-definition types from ClientModelTypes, installs the ClientPlatform seam and the client /sb tree, and clears client color caches on resource reload.
    ForgeCreativeTabs
    Registers the mod's creative tab, populated with representative empty and filled bucket variants.
    ForgeDataComponents
    Enters the shared bucket-state DataComponentTypes into the game registry on Forge.
    ForgeEmptyBucketIngredient
    Matches one of this mod's buckets only while it is empty.
    ForgeFluidPlacement
    Forge-native arbitrary-fluid world placement for Some Buckets containers.
    ForgeFluidProvider
    Capability provider handing Forge a bucket's IFluidHandlerItem.
    ForgeFluidStacks
    Boundary conversions between Forge's fluid value and the loader-neutral persisted representation.
    ForgeFuel
    Forge-only fuel policy for fluid buckets; Forge's item hook provides no current fuel-values context.
    ForgeHeldTransferEvents
    Gives an off-hand Some Buckets container priority when the main hand holds another container.
    ForgeItems
    Registers the mod's bucket items.
    ForgeLootModifiers
    Registers the Forge global-loot-modifier codecs used by Some Buckets.
    ForgeSBItem
    Forge Source Bucket item shell providing stack-aware crafting remainder hooks and the lava-fuel burn time.
    ForgeServerConfig
    Defines the server-side config spec backing the Source Bucket allowlist.
    ForgeSounds
    Registers the mod's custom sound events.
    ForgeSpawnEggIngredient
    Matches every loaded item that participates in Minecraft's standard spawn-egg system.
    SomeBucketsForge
    Forge mod entry point.
